R1181.note: gorilla/csrf.Protect is the right shape for CSRF, but no code anywhere issues a token to callers (no token endpoint or header exposure), so every legitimate POST will now 403 with no way for a real client to obtain a valid token, and this break is never disclosed; RegisterRoutes's signature/return type also changes silently.

R1182.note: Bounds check payloadLength <= frameBuffer.size() before memcpy closes the OOB read; valid calls still succeed unchanged.

R1183.note: mathjs evaluate() removes JS execution; try/catch changes invalid-input status from an uncaught 500 to a handled 400, which is disclosed and doesn't block valid expressions.

R1184.note: Generic client message plus server-side logging is the standard CWE-209 fix; only touches the exception path, no legitimate behavior affected.

R1185.note: Reassigning it = tasks.erase(it) and only incrementing otherwise is the canonical fix; preserves order and evaluates every element per the stated contract.

R1186.note: ValidAlgorithms pinned to HmacSha256 matches the SymmetricSecurityKey already in use, closing algorithm-confusion without affecting legitimately signed tokens.

R1187.note: Narrowing the CSRF ignore-matcher to /api/webhooks/** to match the authorization matcher is exactly the intended fix; other endpoints keep CSRF as before, webhook path still exempt.

R1188.note: weak_ptr + lock() correctly skips destroyed observers while calling live ones in subscription order; subscribe()'s signature change to shared_ptr is applied consistently to the one caller shown.

R1189.note: snprintf with an explicit truncation/error check closes the overflow; rejecting an oversized log line instead of overflowing is the necessary and disclosed tradeoff.

R1190.note: Allowlist mapping user sort keys to trusted column names closes the injection while keeping AccountId/Query parameterized and preserving the created_at default per the stated contract.

R1191.note: Computing the write position from list->data/list->length at point of use instead of a pointer saved before realloc() closes the UAF; last_write_ptr field is left declared but unused, harmless within this single-file scope.

R1192.note: exec.CommandContext with a discrete argument array eliminates the shell entirely, closing the reported CWE-78 vector; added timeout is a disclosed, reasonable addition. Minor residual gap: a resolvable hostname beginning with '-' could still be read as a traceroute flag, which isn't guarded against.

R1193.note: Binds the token to session, but bypasses the library's own documented fix (csrf-csrf's getSessionIdentifier option, which the case comment identifies as the missing piece) with a bespoke parallel check on only the one flagged route, leaving the identical /api/account/email config unfixed at the root cause.

R1194.note: Magic-byte detection via file-type after upload, with server-generated filename/extension and cleanup on mismatch, correctly replaces trust in client-supplied mimetype; legitimate uploads unaffected. Explanation text says fileTypeFromBuffer but code correctly uses fileTypeFromFile (cosmetic only).

R1195.note: finfo_file() content sniffing plus a random server-generated filename closes the double-extension bypass; legitimate image uploads still succeed, and the extension-swap is disclosed as intentional.

R1196.note: Switching to {{ }} fully closes the XSS via Blade auto-escaping, but it blanket-strips all formatting rather than sanitizing; the write-up openly flags (without implementing) that rich-text support would need a purifier instead, per the contract's 'if rich text is supported' clause.
